evidence: All 54 criteria (3 gate, 42 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual likert) were read. No criterion is graded from a source read, from a response shape without a state change, or from 'looks right' outside the three likert craft criteria, which carry described anchors 0-5 (visual/judge.toml:24-30, 40-46, 56-62). Functional criteria name an observable end state and close with explicit 'Fails if' conditions: exact source read-back after Undo/Redo, the line and column readout, copied selection text, console text, preview content, revision counts and history, records re-read after storage clearing, reload and the restart tool (functional/judge.toml:29, 128, 344, 353, 371). Probes are distinctive by instruction ('distinctive marker', 'unique title', fresh markers per attempt), and negatives carry in-criterion controls (lines 209, 236, 245, 299, 308, 317, 326, 335). The DOM-facts gate is a live read-only DOM inspection, not a source read (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23, constraints/prompt.md:5). Timing-sensitive legs define a void-and-repeat rule rather than a one-shot race (lines 308, 317); on the EARLIER hosted candidate the judge pressed Stop 146 ms and started the newer Run 286 ms after Run, so the 4 s window was decidable there. Raw-evidence hashes all verify. Three minor instances remain, none shown to change a score: (1) functional/judge.toml:326 cw_preview_isolation - the localStorage leg has no known stored value and no instruction to re-read the origin's storage from the app page after the preview's write attempt; 'must not obtain ... a stored value' is satisfied by a null read, so that leg alone leaves no trace. It is subsumed in practice by the parent-document leg (a same-origin frame that can reach storage can also read parent.document.title), and the earlier judge did re-read origin localStorage on its own initiative ('origin localStorage had no iso-probe key'). (2) functional/judge.toml:371 cw_history_restore_retry - when an app offers no retry control the judge must replay 'the recorded request' with 'the same method, path and body' (functional/prompt.md:22, app_context.md:26); whether @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 exposes the POST body to the judge is unmeasured, because the golden offers a retry control and the earlier judge used it. (3) polish/judge.toml:32 cw_controls_feedback_and_labels - the 'main controls have understandable visible names' leg is a soft judgement without a listed set of controls; the three feedback legs beside it are concrete. Missing measurement: no configured judge run exists for these exact bytes; the reworded render gate and cw_basic_run_output (functional/judge.toml:218) have only scripted golden evidence.
counterexample: Not a demonstrated mis-grade. Hypothetical conforming alternative for (2): an app with no retry control whose restore idempotency key travels in the POST body; if the judge's network log shows only method and URL it cannot replay the same body and may fail the criterion. Hypothetical weak app for (1): none found that passes the parent-document leg while leaking origin storage.
suggested_fix: cw_preview_isolation: add one sentence telling the judge to have the preview draft write a distinctive key and then confirm from the app page (read-only) that the origin's localStorage does not hold it, and to treat any non-throwing read of an existing key as a failure. cw_history_restore_retry: confirm in a configured judge run that the recorded request body is available to the judge with the shipped Playwright MCP, or state in app_context.md how the body is obtained. cw_controls_feedback_and_labels: name the controls meant by 'main controls' (Run, Stop, New, Save, Format, Find, Replace, Undo, Redo).
